item.tib: yang zab gu ru'i thugs sgrab las phrin las dregs tshogs 'joms byed
item.coloph: zhes o rgyan thugs kyi sras mchog rig 'dzin chen po gar dbang bstan gnyis gling pas spyan drangs pa'i gter chos 'di la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum yod kyang 'di ni mdo khams sa yi lte ba la rna chen brag dkar rdo rje yang rdzong dung gi seng ge la g.yu yi ral pa brgyan 'dra ba'i dal nas rin po che shog ser gru gang ba la mkha' 'gro'i brda ris phreng bzhi bcu rtsa lnga bzhugs pa spyan drangs nas shing mo bya yi lo bkra shis mthong smon gling du zhal bshus te/ yi ge rig byed skal bzang chos 'di'i mthun gyur g.yung drung tshul khrims bstan 'dzin dbang pos bgyis pa'o//
